{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion issues
print("Number of NaN values in 'revenue' after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows to confirm
print("First 5 rows:")
print(sales_df.head())

# Check for 'campaign' period definition
print("Columns in the dataset:", sales_df.columns.tolist())

# Check 'status' column values completely, without truncation
print("Unique values in 'status' column (full list):", sales_df['status'].unique())"}
